meta.name: Haq Se 720p
meta.description:
Four blood-bound sisters with four passionate dreams, all yearning for one thing: fulfilment. This is a modern-day story of dreams, desires, love, war and the eternal pursuit of happiness, set against the breathtaking beauty and unsettling unrest of Kashmir.

Ended · First aired 2 Feb 2018 · India · Language: Hindi · 25 min
Studio: Manor Rama Pictures · Network: ALTBalaji, Bollywood بالعربي

Complete series. On your server: S1 20/20

On your server — Audio: Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: The Mirza Girls
videos.overview: Meet the Mirza sisters, Meher, Jannat, Bahira, and Amal, as they give you a peek into Kashmir, beyond its beautiful valleys, politics, and curfew.

videos.title: The Imperfect Affair
videos.overview: When you love alone, the consequences are far too many. The Mirza family will learn this the hard way.

videos.title: Blogs for Dogs
videos.overview: Jannat Mirza writes a blog. She thinks her writing is helping Kashmiri society, but her family doesn’t think so, as a lot of people are unhappy. How will the family survive this storm?

videos.title: Jashn!
videos.overview: It is Tabish’s birthday and he throws a party. The Mirzas are invited. Bahira Mirza debuts as a singer and enthralls the guests.

videos.title: Gone Viral
videos.overview: Bahira’s music is a ray of happiness for the Mirza family. It’s the beginning of a new journey for Jashn.

videos.title: Fans and Fanatics
videos.overview: Many in Kashmir find the sounds of Bahira’s band, Jashn, intolerable. How will Jashn survive his opposition?

videos.title: Stuck Between Heaven And Hell
videos.overview: Jashn is set for their first-ever concert. But they are forced to flee even before they begin.

videos.title: Main Kashmir Hoon
videos.overview: The turmoil is rising all around the Mirzas. The unrest has significantly touched the lives of Bahira and Jannat.

videos.title: Conflict Zones
videos.overview: Journalism that offends gets it right. Jannat Mirza’s blog finds support as well as opposition all over Kashmir. There is a new guest in town, what will he bring with him? Trouble or hope?

videos.title: Of Hope And Fatwas
videos.overview: The new guest in town impresses everyone except Tabish. Dr. Naushad does everything to save his daughter.

videos.title: Surgical Strike
videos.overview: Maulwi Mohammad Altaaf agrees to speak to Jannat and Raghu. How will he justify his declaration of Fatwa on Bano?

videos.title: Accidental Coincidences
videos.overview: Jannat is lovesick, but Amal is jealous. Bahira is hopeful and so is Tabish.  On the other hand, rumours and gossip surround Meher and Dr. Naushad.

videos.title: Waqt-e-Sehar
videos.overview: At the Iftar gathering, an ugly confrontation takes place between Jannat, Tabish, and Raghu. Is this the end of Jannat and Tabish’s friendship?

videos.title: Too Close For Comfort
videos.overview: An invitation, an unfortunate incident, and few broken hearts. This Iftar will be remembered for all the right reasons, but also for a few wrong ones.

videos.title: Straight To Hell
videos.overview: In her pursuit of truth, Jannat fears losing Raghu, who doesn’t want to be in Kashmir anymore. With a hopeful eye on the future, Meher struggles to handle her past.

videos.title: Hide and Seek
videos.overview: Meher is not alone, as her sisters stand by her. Whatever happened to Meher has a deep impact on Amal. What does the future hold for Mirza sisters?

videos.title: Aakhri Aafreen
videos.overview: The Mirza sisters choose silence over justice. It’s suffocating but brings a semblance of peace. But for how long?

videos.title: Breathless
videos.overview: Some new ties are formed while the old ones break apart. A scandal breaks and divides Naushad and Meher even before they could come any closer.

videos.title: Alvida
videos.overview: With the declaration of a curfew, Amal and Bahira go missing. What ensues is a desperate search for lost hopes and dreams.

videos.title: Season Finale: End Of The Beginning
videos.overview: The Mirzas lose a part of themselves to Kashmir and its complications. What remain are just memories of a serene past. For the Mirzas, life in Kashmir will never be the same again.
